design_detail: EU own resource based on a progressive wealth tax for individuals or private households (A9-0155/2023 Amendment 2)
source_title: European Parliament roll-call vote 129, 10 May 2023: A9-0155/2023 Amendment 2
grading_note: Named in the affirmative roster (196 for, 383 against) of Amendment 2, which calls on the Commission to propose a new own resource based on a wealth tax for individuals or private households (paragraph 29a, amendment text read in the archived original).

design_detail: asset taxes (varamaksud) and taxes on rich people, 'in the long run'
quote_original: Pikaajaliselt kindlasti. Ma arvan varamaksud, jõukate, rikaste inimeste või ettevõtete maksud – Eesti sellest ei pääse.
quote_en: In the long run certainly. I believe that asset taxes, taxes on wealthy, rich people or businesses - there's no escaping it for Estonia.
source_title: Läänemets: pikas vaates Eesti vara- ja rikaste maksudest ei pääse
grading_note: Speaker's own words to ERR as SDE chair and interior minister. 'Varamaksud' can cover property taxes and he names no base, rate or threshold, so grade C; he links it to a progressive income tax in the same breath.

design_detail: wealth taxes (varamaksud) in place of a progressive income tax; no rate or threshold
quote_original: Varamaksud seevastu on oma olemuselt proportsionaalsed või progresseeruvad rikkuse suhtes ning tabavad peamiselt jõukamaid inimesi, aidates ebavõrdsust vähendada.
quote_en: Wealth taxes, by contrast, are by their nature proportional or progressive with respect to wealth and mainly hit the better-off, helping to reduce inequality.
source_title: Kerly Randlane: maksustame rikkust, mitte edukust
grading_note: Opinion piece titled 'Tax wealth, not success' arguing for wealth taxes by name (and against a progressive income tax); gives no design, so grade B.
